narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our exploration of trigonometric ratios! In this lesson, we'll dive into the fundamental concepts of trigonometry, focusing on how angles and sides of triangles relate to each other. By the end, you'll have a clear understanding of what trigonometric ratios are and why they are essential in mathematics. Let's begin our journey into this exciting topic!
